case: returns draft content from overlay when live preview mode is active
why: The test dispatches a Contentstack postMessage with draft content and asserts that getContentByKey returns the draft value rather than the published value, which would fail if draft content were not displayed without a publish action.
vc: When a content entry is edited and saved as a draft in the CMS, the rendered page displays the draft version of that content without requiring a publish action.

case: updates rendered content in real time when a new draft value arrives via postMessage
why: The test renders the hook, then dispatches a new postMessage with updated draft content and asserts the value changed to the new draft without any re-mount or page refresh, so it would fail if real-time updates did not occur.
vc: When a draft content value is updated in the CMS while the page is open, the rendered page updates to reflect the new draft value in real time without a manual page refresh.

case: ignores overlay content when live preview mode is not active even if messages were received
why: It disables preview mode, sends draft content via postMessage, then asserts the returned value is the published value, so it would fail if draft content leaked through when preview is inactive.
vc: When live preview mode is not active, the rendered page displays only published content values.
